[[File:DevilsCrevasse-Legacy2006-33.jpg|thumb|The [[Sea Leviathan]] being dragged into the Devil's Crevasse.]]
'''Devil's Crevasse''' was a fissure located on the [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] floor of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] and was home to a large population of [[Devilsquid]]s; creatures for which the crevasse had been named.

In [[137 ABY]], during the [[Genocide on Dac]], Devil's Crevasse was the site of the a [[Battle of Devil's Crevasse|battle]] in which an [[Imperial Knight]] named [[Treis Sinde]] used Devilsquids to help [[Mon Calamari Rangers]] overcome the [[Sea Leviathan]], a massive [[Sithspawn/Legends|creature]] created by [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Vul Isen]] to enforce in the extermination of the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The Devilsquids attacked the [[Leviathan (Interdictor-class cruiser)|Leviathan]] and dragged it to the depths of Devil's Crevasse.
